statement.zh: 确定是相同之下的确定的命名情形，关于配置如何相关的律在相同之下成立，包括描述何时承载规律；对相同者之一的干预、没有主张分开的过去与没有主张分开的描述需要相等。
statement.en: Determinacy is the named case of determinacy up to likeness, and the laws on how configurations relate hold up to likeness, including when a description carries a law; an intervention on one of alike configurations, a past no claim tells apart and a description no claim tells apart need equality.

laws.zh: 主张命名配置时，确定就是相同之下的确定，所以每个以确定陈述的定理都是一个在相同之下陈述者的命名实例。
laws.en: Determinacy is determinacy up to likeness where the claims name the configurations, so each theorem stated with determinacy is the named instance of one stated up to likeness.

laws.zh: 经相同而同行就是相同之下的确定，相同的运行保持相同；以相等陈述的对应者是其命名实例。
laws.en: Going alike through likeness is determinacy up to likeness, and runs alike stay alike; the counterparts stated with equality are their named instances.

laws.zh: 一步不依赖的在相同之下被重新吸收；遗忘噪声后，标准模型恰在噪声在相同之下无差别时在相同之下确定。
laws.en: What the step does not depend on is re-absorbed up to likeness; with the noise forgotten, the standard model is determined up to likeness exactly where the noise makes no difference up to likeness.

laws.zh: 所取的动作在相同之下固定，一次代表其类；在与所命名者相同的配置处从未取的动作，对在一个主张上不同的结果不被固定，经对整个相同类的干预。
laws.en: A move taken is fixed up to likeness and one occasion stands for its class; a move taken at no configuration alike to the one named is not fixed, for outcomes that differ in a claim, through an intervention on a whole likeness class.

laws.zh: 框架在相同之下确定、运行中没有配置与先前的相同时，在运行经过的每个配置处，记录在相同之下不固定那里所取动作以外的任何动作，对在一个主张上不同的结果。
laws.en: Where the frame is determined up to likeness and no configuration of a run is alike to an earlier one, at each configuration the run passes the record fixes up to likeness no move other than the one taken there, for outcomes that differ in a claim.

laws.zh: 描述在相同之下承载规律，恰当描述上有一个等价关系只联系实现同样主张的描述，并以一个动作把描述被它联系的配置带到描述被它联系的配置；承载者是在该等价下闭合的像。
laws.en: A description carries a law up to likeness exactly where some equivalence on descriptions relates only descriptions realizing the same claims and takes configurations whose descriptions it relates, by one move, to configurations whose descriptions it relates; the carrier is the image closed under the equivalence.

laws.zh: 每个描述就是自己的主张时，这样的等价只有相等，这就是以相等陈述的律；什么也不主张时，每个描述都承载规律。
laws.en: Where each description is its own claim, the only such equivalence is equality, and this is the law stated with equality; with nothing claimed, every description carries a law.

laws.zh: 像恰在描述在其中相同的配置在其下同行时在相同之下确定；描述可以在相同之下承载规律而它的像在相同之下不确定，所以在相同之下像不再是最小的承载者。
laws.en: The image is determined up to likeness exactly where configurations whose descriptions are alike in it go alike under it; a description can carry a law up to likeness while its image is not determined up to likeness, so up to likeness the image is no longer the least carrier.

laws.zh: 差别制造的二分只需以该动作由扣除后的配置出发的每一步到达条件的同一水平：此时或者那一部分造成差别，或者同一动作仍断裂依存；分开该水平的主张之下的相同之下的确定，以及确定，都是其情形。
laws.en: The dichotomy of difference-making needs only that every step by the move from the withheld configuration reaches one level of the condition: then either the part makes the difference or the same move still breaks the dependence; determinacy up to likeness under claims telling that level apart, and determinacy, are cases.

laws.zh: 经投影读时，在与所命名者相同的描述处未取的动作，在相同之下不被固定，对在一个主张上不同的结果：在描述上任何相同之下确定、容许如此读的各步的过程之下都是如此，所以凡是有尊重主张的等价使配置同行之处都是如此。
laws.en: Read through a projection, a move not taken at a description alike to the one named is not fixed up to likeness, for outcomes that differ in a claim: so under any process on the descriptions, determined up to likeness, that admits the steps so read, and so wherever some equivalence respecting the claims makes configurations go alike.

laws.zh: 对相同配置之一的干预破坏相同之下的确定；保留的历史在没有主张分开过去时在相同之下返回，所以保留的历史只在有主张分开过去时是新的。
laws.en: An intervention on one of two alike configurations breaks determinacy up to likeness; a kept history returns up to likeness where its present does and no claim tells the past apart, so a kept history is new only where a claim tells its past apart.

laws.zh: 什么也不主张时，没有混杂被排除。
laws.en: With nothing claimed, no confound is excluded.

hypotheses.zh: 不加前提：每条律写出自己的条件，其中有用到之处的相同之下的确定，以及分开所比较者的主张；相同是互模拟，不取商。
hypotheses.en: No premise: each law states its conditions, among them determinacy up to likeness where it is used and claims that tell apart what is compared; likeness is bisimulation, with no quotient taken.

does_not_show.zh: 陈述某过程确定的实例保持原样；Determined.at 给出它们的相同之下的确定。
does_not_show.en: Instances stating that a process is determined are left as they are; Determined.at gives their determinacy up to likeness.

detail.zh: Twins.retarget_breaks：对两个相同孪生之一的改送破坏相同之下的确定。
detail.en: Twins.retarget_breaks: retargeting one of two alike twins breaks determinacy up to likeness.

detail.zh: Parting：起点以同一动作到一个能继续的配置和一个不能继续的配置；经恒等映射，像在起点处在相同之下不确定，而什么也不主张时恒等映射在相同之下承载规律（Parting.image_not_determinedAt、Parting.carries）。
detail.en: Parting: from the start one move leads to a configuration that can go on and to one that cannot; through the identity the image is not determined up to likeness at the start, while with nothing claimed the identity carries a law up to likeness (Parting.image_not_determinedAt, Parting.carries).

next_delta.en: A characterization of the laws that need a split finer than the claims, beyond the three witnesses.

correspondence.zh: 读法（AI 的；Ren 2026-10-14 同意此方向）：相同是展开自身的配置同一；在相同之下成立的确定定理关乎配置如何相关，需要相等的那些依赖于主张所分开的（相等是最细的切分，即命名，规律 1）：对相同者中一个名字的干预、没有主张分开的过去、没有主张分开的描述。没有主张分开的既不被固定也不被排除（比较 Becoming.Testing 中形成能检验的主张）。在相同之下，承载规律的是一个尊重主张的等价，而不只是像：每个描述就是自己的主张时它是相等。见整合文档 §99 与 Becoming.Likeness 一节。
correspondence.en: Reading (the AI's; Ren agreed with its direction on 14 October 2026): likeness is the unfolding's own identity of configurations; the theorems with determinacy that hold up to likeness are about how configurations relate, and those that need equality depend on what the claims tell apart, equality being the finest split, naming (law 1): an intervention on one name among alike configurations, a past no claim tells apart, a description no claim tells apart. What no claim tells apart is neither fixed nor excluded (compare the claims a formation can test in Becoming.Testing). Up to likeness a law is carried by an equivalence that respects the claims, not by the image alone; where each description is its own claim, that equivalence is equality. See §99 of the integration note and its section on Becoming.Likeness.

history.en: 14 October 2026, likeness completed (the work board's likeness row of Current math core; Becoming.Likeness): answers this record's next_delta. New laws 5–10: the exact form of carries_law_iff up to likeness (carries_law_alike_iff, with carries_law_named_iff as the named instance); the image's determinacy up to likeness (image_determinedAt_iff), with Parting showing that up to likeness the image is no longer the least carrier; not_fixes_other_of_new up to likeness; the dichotomy of difference-making from one level after the move; the readings of the experiment laws through a projection up to likeness (Run.not_fixesThroughAlike_of_untaken, Run.not_fixesThroughAlike_of_goAlikeUnder). Migrated to schema 2 at the same time: the claim became 11 laws; the hypothesis that carries_law_iff has no two-way form and the three items the limitations listed as not restated are superseded by the new laws; the hypothesis that not_fixesThrough_* are not restated is answered by law 10, and Determined.at went to a does-not-show item; the readings and the absence of ethical predicates went to standard boundaries and the correspondence. Every earlier sentence is mapped in the migration table [determinacy-up-to-likeness.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/determinacy-up-to-likeness.md); the exact earlier record is the last text_versions entry. Proof bindings for Becoming.Likeness are added after the landing run.
